name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, validate, and beautify JSON data with syntax highlighting, error detection, and tree view — all validated against IETF RFC 8259 for U.S. developers and students.
longDescription: JSON Formatter is a developer essential for working with JSON data. Paste raw JSON to instantly format with proper indentation and syntax highlighting. Validates syntax against IETF RFC 8259 (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259) and highlights errors with line numbers. Collapsible tree view for navigating large objects. Minify option for production payloads. No data leaves your browser — all processing happens client-side, ensuring privacy for U.S. developers, students, and enterprise users.
pricingDetails: Completely free — $0 cost versus $12–$29/month developer tool subscriptions. No limits, no account required. All processing happens client-side.
features: Syntax highlighting with line-number error detection
IETF RFC 8259 JSON validation for standard-compliant output
Collapsible tree view for navigating large U.S. API payloads
Minify/beautify toggle for production and development workflows
Client-side processing — no data upload, full privacy
Works instantly in modern browsers on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS
useCases: U.S. API response debugging and config file formatting
JSON validation for compliance with IETF RFC 8259
Teaching JSON structure to students and new developers
Enterprise data inspection without uploading sensitive payloads
